title: Is Charging A MacBook Air Using A 100W Adapter Safe? - BGR
summary: Although Apple doesn't explicitly state the charging speeds of different MacBook Air models, the company mentions the required wattage for a power adapter to enable fast charging. The older M1 MacBook Air is, however, limited to 45W charging.
